mentions.name: Golf Playbook
mentions.description: A free, no-subscription iOS golf strategy app that automates course spatial reasoning: given the player's shot dispersion, wind, elevation, and hazards, it displays the recommended aim line visually on a hole flyover rather than as numbers. The latest release adds printable personalized playbooks (print, cut, fold, staple). Course data is built from OpenStreetMap instead of licensed commercial databases, which enables the free pricing; built with SwiftUI and Apple Foundation Models.
mentions.problem: Before each amateur tour event the author spent hours on Google Earth figuring out where to aim on every hole and which club to hit, which became very cumbersome.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So I built Golf Playbook (iOS).

Free, no subscription. Built our course data from OpenStreetMap instead of licensing an expensive commercial database.
